content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I didn't find the red ball, so I stopped and put the robot into rest mode. It is now crouched with its motors off, about 0.4 m forward and 0.6 m to the right of where it started.

I got this wrong along the way. I took a red object near the wall for the ball and walked toward it, but it turned out to be part of a chair. The red things in the later scans were also chair seats. The full scans from the start position and from the turned position showed no ball, so it may be behind the robot, out of the camera's view, or somewhere the robot couldn't see.

If you want me to keep searching, I can stand the robot up and scan from a new spot, or turn it around to check the area behind.
